content: GAIL (India) Limited is recognized as the largest natural gas transportation company in India, encompassing all facets of the natural gas value chain. The company, originally known as Gas Authority of India Ltd, serves as the primary entity for gas transmission and marketing in India. It was established by the Government of India in August 1984 with the objective of developing infrastructure for the gas sector. In 1991, GAIL successfully commissioned the 2800-kilometer Hazira-Vijaipur-Jagdishpur (HVJ) pipeline. Between 1991 and 1993, the company constructed three LPG plants and acquired several regional pipelines, which allowed it to expand its gas transportation operations across various regions of India. In 1997, GAIL initiated its city gas distribution operations in New Delhi by establishing nine CNG stations. By 1999, the company had set up northern India’s only petrochemical plant in Pata. In 2007, Forbes listed GAIL as one of the world’s 2,000 largest public companies.
